column26: Description

User Story:
As a Customer, I want to receive Push Notifications and Email alerts upon status changes (Confirmed, Delivered), So that I stay updated.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given Shop clicking 'Confirm Booking', When event fires, Then sends HTML Email + Push Notification to customer phone.
• Fail: Given Customer opted out of emails, When status changes, Then sends Push Notification only.

Technical Notes:
• NotificationsService.sendBookingNotification() | Nodemailer Template Engine

User Story:
As a Shop, I want to view Top 5 most rented Ao Dai items, So that I can stock up on high-demand inventory.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given query for Top products, When calling API, Then returns HTTP 200 OK showing Top 5 items ordered by rental count descending.
• Fail: Given a new shop with 0 rentals, When querying, Then returns data: [].

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/admin-stats/top-products | Aggregation $sort: { rentalCount: -1 }

User Story:
As a Lead Dev, I want to set up a Socket.io WebSocket Gateway in NestJS, So that real-time messaging & notifications are enabled.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given valid JWT token in handshake auth: { token }, When connecting socket, Then server accepts connection and joins user room.
• Fail: Given invalid token, When connecting, Then server disconnects socket with Unauthorized error.

Technical Notes:
• @WebSocketGateway({ cors: true }) | ChatGateway | Redis Adapter

column1: [VIB-67] AD-DB-05 Database Schemas for Real-time Chat & Notifications
column26:
User Story:
As a Data Engineer, I want to create collections chat_rooms, chat_messages, and notifications, So that real-time chat logs and push alerts are stored cleanly.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given active MongoDB connection, When app boots, Then chat_rooms and notifications collections initialize with indexed fields.
• Fail: Given malformed message payload, When saving, Then Mongoose throws ValidationError.

Technical Notes:
• Schemas: chat_room.schema.ts, chat_message.schema.ts, notification.schema.ts

column1: [VIB-73] [UC-I02] Financial, Refund & Payout Status Alerts (Push Notifications)
column26:
User Story:
As a User / Provider, I want to receive alerts when payments, deposits, refunds, or wallet payout requests are approved/rejected, So that I am informed of financial status.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given 500k deposit refunded to card, When event fires, Then sends notification 'Received 500,000 VND deposit refund for booking BK100'.
• Fail: Given Admin approves wallet payout request, When event fires, Then sends notification 'Your withdrawal request of 1,000,000 VND has been approved'.

Technical Notes:
• Event Listeners: payment.success, refund.completed, payout.approved, payout.rejected

User Story:
As a Customer / Photographer, I want to receive reminders 24h and 2h prior to a shoot, So that I arrive on time.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given shoot scheduled at 9:00 tomorrow, When cronjob scans at 9:00 today, Then automatically dispatches reminders to client and photographer.
• Fail: Given a cancelled booking, When cronjob scans, Then skips reminder dispatch.

Technical Notes:
• @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_HOUR) | BookingsSchedulerService.scanUpcomingBookings()

User Story:
As an Admin, I want to view total active shops and listed products count, So that platform catalog size is monitored.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given 30 active shops and 450 items, When viewing overview, Then returns HTTP 200 OK { totalShops: 30, totalProducts: 450 }.
• Fail: Given large DB, When querying, Then response serves under 100ms utilizing Mongo count index.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/admin-stats/shops-overview | Mongoose .estimatedDocumentCount()

column1: [VIB-87] [UC-K21] Photographer Partner Network & Completed Shoots Count
column26:
User Story:
As an Admin, I want to view total partner photographers and total completed shoots, So that I can report metrics to executive team.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given querying photographer overview, When API executes, Then returns HTTP 200 OK { totalPhotographers: 15, completedShoots: 120 }.
• Fail: Given filter location=HUE, When querying, Then counts Hue-based photographers only.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/admin-stats/photographers-overview | AdminStatsService.getPhotographersOverview()

User Story:
As a Shop / Admin, I want to view total rental order counts and total revenue charts by month, So that business growth is tracked.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given Shop JWT, When viewing dashboard, Then returns HTTP 200 OK with order count (50), revenue (15,000,000 VND), and daily chart payload.
• Fail: Given filter from=2026-01-01&to=2026-01-31, When querying, Then returns precise January analytics data.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/admin-stats/rental-bookings | MongoDB Aggregation Pipeline

User Story:
As an Admin / Photographer, I want to view ranking of most booked photoshoot concepts, So that top-demand concepts are expanded.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given platform booking data, When viewing concept stats, Then returns Top 5 concepts (e.g. 1. Hue Royal Concept - 40% share).
• Fail: Given filtering by Q1/2026, When querying, Then returns precise Q1 rankings.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/admin-stats/popular-concepts | Aggregation on bookings.conceptId

User Story:
As an Admin, I want to view completion rate vs cancellation rate percentages, So that operational bottlenecks are resolved.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given 100 total bookings (80 Completed, 15 Cancelled, 5 Disputed), When viewing metrics, Then returns completionRate: 80%, cancellationRate: 15%, disputeRate: 5%.
• Fail: Given no bookings, When querying, Then returns all metrics at 0%.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/admin-stats/booking-conversion | AdminStatsService.getConversionMetrics()

User Story:
As an Admin / CFO, I want to view total net platform revenue (Commissions + Platform Fees) post-payout, So that company financial health is monitored.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given total platform GMV 100,000,000 VND, When viewing revenue report, Then returns HTTP 200 OK { totalGMV: 100000000, platformRevenue: 11500000, totalPayout: 88500000 }.
• Fail: Given a non-CFO/Admin user attempting access, When requesting, Then returns HTTP 403 Forbidden.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/admin-stats/financial-summary | SettlementsService.getFinancialSummary()

User Story:
As a Photographer, I want to view my upcoming shoot schedule in a Calendar View, So that I manage my work dates.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given 3 scheduled shoots in October, When opening Calendar view, Then dates 5, 10, and 15 display green markers with location details.
• Fail: Given a cancelled shoot, When viewing calendar, Then cancelled slot displays in grey strikethrough.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/photographers/schedules/calendar | PhotographersService.getCalendar()

User Story:
As an Admin, I want to report photographers with ratings <3.5 stars, So that quality warnings or suspensions are issued.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given 2 photographers with rating 3.2, When running report, Then displays list of 2 photographers with negative review details.
• Fail: Given no photographers <3.5 stars, When querying report, Then returns data: [].

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/admin/photographers/low-rating | @Roles(UserRole.ADMIN)

column1: [VIB-85] [UC-K19] Customer Growth & Daily Active Users (DAU / MAU)
column26:
User Story:
As an Admin, I want to track daily new user registrations and active user metrics, So that marketing ROI is evaluated.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given 7-day date range, When opening growth report, Then returns HTTP 200 OK with bar chart payload of daily new users.
• Fail: Given clicking 'Export Excel', When API processes, Then downloads .xlsx file containing user growth logs.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/admin-stats/user-growth | AdminStatsService.getUserGrowth()

column1: [VIB-89] [UC-K25] User Behavior Analytics (High Views, Zero Bookings & Search Terms)
column26:
User Story:
As a Product Manager, I want to view high-view items with 0 bookings and top search terms, So that pricing and search terms are optimized.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given Item X with 500 views and 0 bookings, When behavior engine runs, Then lists Item X under 'Review Pricing / Photo Quality' with HTTP 200 OK.
• Fail: Given term 'Nhat Binh Ao Dai' searched 1,000 times, When reviewing search logs, Then ranks 'Nhat Binh Ao Dai' as #1 Hot Search.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/analytics/user-behavior | Model: Analytics

column1: [VIB-70] [UC-M01] Real-time Chat between Customer and Provider (Shop / Photographer)
column26:
User Story:
As a Customer, I want to chat in real-time and send photo attachments to Shop/Photographer, So that we coordinate booking details.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given User A and User B in room_123, When A sends 'Is size M available?', Then B receives message instantly via socket event receive_message.
• Fail: Given an attached photo, When sending, Then photo uploads to MinIO and renders as thumbnail in chat room.

Technical Notes:
• chat_rooms, chat_messages Collections | Events: send_message, receive_message

User Story:
As a User, I want to see unread message counter badges increment on the chat icon, So that I never miss partner messages.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given user outside active chat room, When new message arrives, Then unread badge counter increments by +1.
• Fail: Given user entering chat room, When room loads, Then unread counter for that room resets to 0.

Technical Notes:
• Socket Event unread_count_update | Model: ChatRoom

User Story:
As a Customer, I want to receive a review reminder after order completion, So that I can share my experience and earn rewards.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given booking completed 2 hours ago, When trigger executes, Then sends notification 'Share your feedback to receive 20k voucher!'.
• Fail: Given customer submitted review previously, When scanning, Then skips reminder.

Technical Notes:
• NotificationsService.sendReviewReminder()

column1: [VIB-69] [UC-I05] Notification Channel Preference Config (Email / App Push Toggle)
column26:
User Story:
As a User, I want to toggle marketing emails on/off in Settings, So that I control communication preferences.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given User toggling Off marketing emails, When saving settings, Then notificationPreferences.marketingEmail sets to false with HTTP 200 OK.
• Fail: Given marketing emails disabled, When a dispute event occurs, Then system critical emails still deliver.

Technical Notes:
• PATCH /api/v1/users/notification-settings | Model: User

User Story:
As a Shop, I want to view percentage breakdown of items Available, Rented, Cleaning, or Damaged, So that stock status is clear.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given a shop with 20 items, When viewing inventory report, Then returns HTTP 200 OK showing 10 Available (50%), 8 In Use (40%), 2 Cleaning (10%).
• Fail: Given expired token, When requesting, Then returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/admin-stats/inventory-breakdown | AdminStatsService.getInventoryBreakdown()

column1: [VIB-79] [UC-K08] Revenue Growth Trends & Wallet Balance Analytics
column26:
User Story:
As an Admin / Shop, I want to compare revenue growth rates across months and view current wallet balance, So that strategic planning is data-driven.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given groupBy=MONTH, When querying, Then returns 12-month array with revenue totals, MoM % growth rates, and wallet balance with HTTP 200 OK.
• Fail: Given groupBy=INVALID, When querying, Then returns HTTP 400 Bad Request.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/admin-stats/revenue-trends | AdminStatsService.getRevenueTrends()

User Story:
As a Photographer, I want to view gross earnings, platform commission paid, and net payout totals, So that I track my income.

Acceptance Criteria:
• Pass: Given 10 completed shoots, When querying earnings, Then returns gross earnings, 12% commission paid, and net payout total with HTTP 200 OK.
• Fail: Given no shoots, When querying, Then returns totalEarnings: 0.

Technical Notes:
• GET /api/v1/photographers/earnings | PhotographersService.getEarnings()
